title: state.snapshot (server → platform, ephemeral)
description: The whole MatchState (§8.2): after connect (`hello`), on assign (`assign`), on state.request / cmd snapshot_now / match.update conflict (`request`), after a reset resume (`reset`), every 60 s while a match runs (`periodic`) and after a failover resume restored its backup (`restored`). Envelope epoch = state.epoch. state = null when idle. Ephemeral: never replayed.

availability_reason.description: Busy reason, as in server.availability; null when available or on older Ready Up.

availability_detail.description: What the busy reason refers to, as server.availability detail.

admins_rev.description: rev of the admins.set list the server has cached (0 = none)
